messages:
hana: quick report: prod tenant with geo-lock started seeing write rejects after a small-scale router shuffle. sticky session cookie hit proxy whose backing region tag had changed.
jorge: seen this. our rotations keep session->instance mapping but instance region can change under the hood.
mei: immediate mitigation: for tenants with residency=STRICT, disable fast-rotate and force-drain. low risk and buys time.
hana: agreed. medium term idea: issue a short-lived signed "residency token" at session create; routers and serving validate locally. token includes region id + ttl, signed by control plane.
jorge: perf note: ed25519 verify is cheap but cache per-session to avoid per-request crypto. tokens should include key-id for quick lookup.
mei: key questions: default-on-verify-fail policy? legal wants deny for EU; ops wants staged rollout. propose: cluster config default, but enforce deny for STRICT tenants immediately.
ops-bot: Canary note: staging fast-rotate caused 0.15% residency-mismatch; canary rolled back automatically.
hana: action items: hana -> draft tiny RFC for residency tokens + region taxonomy; jorge -> spike proxy verify + LRU cache (1-2d); mei -> ops PR to force-drain STRICT tenants and add telemetry tile for token_mismatch. Will return with RFC link in 48h.
